subject: Private Offer SKU bundling + partner margin guardrails
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@clearmind.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearmind.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: SKU bundling and partner margin — initial ask

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ClearMind is excited about Redwood's latency profile for embedding retrieval. Procurement asked me to kick off the private offer conversation so we can map pricing to our go-live window (Q4). Two specific asks from our side: 1) a recommended SKU bundling (we want a single metered SKU + an optional support addon) and 2) a partner margin floor — our reseller (DataForge Partners) expects ~18% net. We need a proposal that:

- Keeps list price within our procurement band (we've historically targeted $0.08/token for enterprise usage profiles)
- Allows a partner pass-through that lands DataForge at ~18% after marketplace fees
- Includes a clear invoicing route for the reseller (they prefer billing via AWS Marketplace private offer)

Attached: preferred_terms.pdf with our standard PO language (we can redline). Can you propose a structure we can evaluate with procurement?

Tom
Procurement Lead — ClearMind AI

Attachments: clearmind_preferred_terms.pdf (PDF, 248KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@clearmind.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU bundling and partner margin — initial ask

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the terms doc. High level proposal below; attaching a simple pricing grid for clarity.

Proposal (draft):
- Metered SKU: "redwood-inference.standard" priced at $0.075/token list (suitable for heavy embedding + gen mixed workloads)
- Support add-on: flat $2,500/mo (optional, 24x7 SLA)
- Commitment bands (annualized):
  * Band A: $250k+ commit — 9% platform rebate to ClearMind (applies to list price)
  * Band B: $500k+ commit — 14% rebate
  * Band C: $1M+ commit — 20% rebate

Partner pass-through: we can set up the private offer so that DataForge receives reseller uplift as a post-invoice commission. To land DataForge at ~18% net, we would set the marketplace visible discount such that: list price $0.075 -> after Redwood rebate and marketplace fee -> reseller receives ~18%. Ben (cc) will validate the waterfall and tax assumptions.

Operational notes:
- Irene, can you confirm AWS Marketplace private offer routing for this flow (invoice to DataForge vs invoice to ClearMind)?
- Tom, if the partner insists on billing via marketplace, we'll need to align on commitment owner and who holds the PO.

Next steps: 1) Ben to send waterfall calc, 2) Irene to confirm invoice routing, 3) Vanessa to issue a formal PO-ready private offer draft once we align.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: redwood_pricing_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@clearmind.ai>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU bundling and partner margin — initial ask

Team — quick waterfall and sensitivity (see inline). I've also attached a CSV with the SKU mapping for marketplace SKU ids.

Assumptions used:
- Marketplace transaction fee: 7% (AWS MP)
- Redwood rebate = commitment band percent applied to list price
- Reseller commission paid as percentage of net revenue after marketplace fee (common practice)

Example math (Band B — $500k commit):
- List price: $0.075/token
- Redwood rebate 14% -> effective platform net = $0.0645/token
- Marketplace fee 7% on list -> $0.00525/token (marketplace collects from list)
- Revenue pool for reseller: (list - rebate - marketplace fee) approximates? In practice reseller commission is calculated on net after marketplace fee; to land reseller at 18% we set commission rate = 18% / (1 - platform rebate share) -> approx 21% gross commission on net.

I'll deliver a spreadsheet with cell-level sensitivity for commit bands and two scenarios: (A) reseller billed via ClearMind (invoice open to ClearMind, Redwood pays reseller commission) and (B) reseller is the billing entity on AWS MP (invoice to reseller). Scenario B needs confirmation from Irene on constraints.

Attachments: sku_mapping_v1.csv

-ben

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@clearmind.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU bundling and partner margin — initial ask

Vanessa / Ben / Tom — operational clarity:

1) Billing paths supported on AWS MP private offers:
   - Invoice to buyer (ClearMind): Redwood invoices ClearMind; Redwood pays reseller commission via separate agreement.
   - Invoice to reseller (DataForge): The reseller must have marketplace seller enrollment and accept billing; in that case the reseller is the contract holder with AWS and Redwood's revenue recognition changes — we need legal sign-off and a reseller agreement.

2) Tax and passthrough: if DataForge invoices ClearMind, they will likely gross up VAT/Sales tax; our commission calculation must account for tax exclusive/inclusive treatment.

3) DocuSign / contract flow: for Scenario B (reseller is invoice owner) we require: reseller agreement, updated PO language acknowledging reseller billing, and an AWS marketplace enrollment proof. Without those, we recommend Scenario A to avoid revenue recognition complexity.

I can run a quick ops checklist if you want me to take the lead.

-Irene
Head of Deal Ops, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@clearmind.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jul 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU bundling and partner margin — initial ask

Tom — thanks, all. Quick recap and ask from ClearMind so we can produce a PO-ready private offer:

- Preferred approach: Scenario A (invoice to ClearMind, Redwood pays reseller commission). That keeps contracting simple and preserves ClearMind procurement flow.
- Commitment band target: Band B ($500k+ annual) — Tom, can you confirm whether procurement can commit to that band? If yes we will deliver the private offer with Band B economics (list $0.075/token, 14% rebate).
- Partner uplift: we'll set reseller commission as a percentage that lands DataForge at ~18% net in the Band B scenario; Ben will include the exact commission rate in the spreadsheet.

Action items:
- Tom: confirm $500k+ commit by EOD Monday (Jul 29). If not, tell us which band you prefer.
- Ben: final waterfall spreadsheet and the exact commission rate for Band B (sensitivity: include marketplace fee at 7%).
- Irene: prep ops checklist for Scenario A and a short note on invoice timing.

Once we have those, I'll draft the private offer and start the DocuSign flow (we'll attach the redlined terms you provided).

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
